title: BlyggerPress shared wire constructs
description: Shared $defs for the Blygger 0.3 wire surface. These schemas are READER-ACCEPTANCE schemas: they describe the known structure of each construct and deliberately set additionalProperties:true so that the reader ignore-unknown rule (spec 3, 13.1 rule 4) is encoded rather than violated. Emit-strictness for our own publisher is captured in each schema's x-emit-required annotation and checked by publication fixtures.

Id.description: 128 random bits as 26 lowercase Crockford base32 chars (spec 5.1).

BlygKey.description: Protocol version key. Informative, not a negotiation; readers accept any 0.x (spec 3.1).

Iso8601Utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp ending in Z (spec 4).

Kind.description: Known item kinds. Readers treat unknown kinds as unknown constructs (spec 5.3).

Relation.description: The exact mention relation set at 0.3 (spec 15.4).

Author.description: Client-asserted, opaque publication identity / byline (spec 5.5). Any members are permitted; readers MUST accept any object and never reject an item over it.

MediaEntry.description: An immutable media object referenced by an item (spec 5.4).

ChangelogEntry.description: Publish-event metadata. Never content or a diff (spec 5.2).

Selector.description: W3C Web Annotation text-quote selector for a partial transclusion (spec 10.3). exact is the normalized selection.

Cited.description: The human half of a citation, frozen when the reference was made (spec 5.9). Self-asserted; ignored by mention verification; never baked into content_html.

Reference.description: Citation naming one published version of one item at one origin (spec 5.9). origin is optional here because transclusions[] omit it for own-origin sources; use AbsoluteReference where origin is REQUIRED.

AbsoluteReference.description: A reference whose origin is REQUIRED (forked_from, stub_of, remote transclusions[]) (spec 5.9).

Transclusion.description: A transclusions[] entry: a Reference that optionally carries a partial selector (spec 10.3).

StubOf.description: A stub's single target: a blyg reference (origin REQUIRED) or a plain-web {url} target; either shape MAY carry cited (spec 10.6).

GeneratedSource.description: One own-origin source drawn on by a generator span at 0.3. origin is not expressible here (spec 5.7 rule 1).

GeneratedSpan.description: One generated span's provenance shadow (spec 5.7). MUST NOT carry instruction text.
